about: The loading screen's hint list. Filled once per process; no level, save load or return to the menu reloads it. Its count at +0x14 is read at each draw: lowered from Lua in the menu, the next loads drew only from the first entries.

the fork F5 (v34-start-hints-1) made two more managers this way, loaded a mod's Hints.lsx into each through ls::FileFormatIO::LoadFile (2 entries each), moved the entries into a 51-element array it built in the same form (header 51, capacity 51, count 51) and destroyed the rest through slot 1; the main menu and two loads ran on it with the loading screen drawing from the 51

count written 49->3 with GK.Memory.Write in the main menu; a save load (HintShown HINT_CAM_ZOOM 1/3) and a return to the menu (HINT_CAM_ZOOM 1/3) drew within 3 and the count stayed 3 after both loads; restored to 49
